title: Report a problem
summary: Sends a problem report that the user starts, with an optional screenshot and, only when the user turns it on, the app logs (ADR 0114). Files stay on the Bipe server in Brazil for 90 days; the team answers in the Suporte Bipe chat.

of.description: A local image the user picked.

phase.description: sent: bipe_help_report_sent_title and bipe_help_report_sent_body. failed: see error.

editText.effect: Sets text. Send works when text is not empty after trimming.

toggleLogs.effect: Sets includeLogs for this report only. The next report starts off again.

addScreenshot.effect: Opens the system photo picker for one image. Never takes a screenshot by itself.

send.effect: POST /v1/bug-reports/submit as multipart: text, app (the application ID), user_agent (iOS or Android), version and build from product/version.json, os, the screenshots as file, and the compressed app logs as compressed-log only when includeLogs. 200: sent. 413 and other errors: failed with bipe_app_report_error. 429: bipe_error_rate_limited.

close.effect: Closes the screen. A text that was not sent is dropped.

notes: Signed-in users only: the request carries the Matrix access token (401 without it). 10 reports per hour per account. Body limit 50 MB.
Only reports the user starts. No shake gesture, no automatic crash report, no telemetry. Nothing goes to Sentry, PostHog or an Element server (ADR 0114, plan section 2).
The logs are the app's own log files, with no message text, no PIN, no password and no token. The app writes its logs that way from the start; the report does not filter them.

The API keeps text, logs and screenshots on the server in Brazil for 90 days, and sends only the text and metadata to Starlings with a staff-only link. The bot posts bipe_support_report_received into the user's support room (support-open). product/data.json and product/privacy.json already list this.
The multipart field names are the API contract (api/openapi.yaml /v1/bug-reports/submit). Do not add fields.
Bipe logic: the forks send this form from Element's rageshake code, which the new client must not copy. Write the multipart request from the contract.

When account-start found legacy data of the earlier Bipe app on this phone (legacyKept, bipe-chat/bipe#603), includeLogs also sends legacy-data.json as one more compressed-log part: structure only, never a value (account-start notes). It is there also after the account came back, as long as the legacy data is on the phone.
